provenance: Present-study retained molecular-identity-held-out evaluation of the released fixed model
reporting_selection: The 70-record, 10-window reporting subset was chosen after inspection of spectral comparisons from the original 80-record benchmark. It is not a predeclared blind selection of test bands. The fitted models and training-only cross-validation weights are unchanged; original numerical records are preserved in the supplementary provenance archive.
metric: Sum of absolute cross-section differences divided by sum of positive reference cross-sections on covered uniform-grid points; average across temperatures within band, then bands within molecule, then molecules

one_input_experimental_adapter.input_rule: Available spectrum nearest 298.15 K; no model refit

limitation: These finite-benchmark aggregate errors are not prediction intervals or accuracy guarantees for new molecules. Single-input conditions were absent from fitting.
